projects.title: Aortic Valve Disease Progression Predictor
descr: Built a Python machine learning model using scikit-learn and pandas to predict aortic stenosis/regurgitation progression timelines based on clinical data from 50+ published studies, achieving 85% accuracy in severity classification.

Implemented gradient boosted trees (XGBoost) to analyze echocardiographic parameters and patient demographics, identifying key risk factors for disease progression and optimal surgical intervention timing.

Applied K-Means clustering to segment patients into risk categories and used neural networks (TensorFlow) to predict valve replacement type recommendations (mechanical vs. bioprosthetic vs. Ross procedure).

projects.title: Snoono - Sleep Aid App
descr: Developed an iOS application using Swift with integrated NFC technology and IoT device connectivity to create a comprehensive sleep and productivity solution that eliminates habits of snoozing.
Built app blocking features and integrated IoT devices (sunrise lamps, smart alarms) using Core NFC framework and HomeKit to improve user wake-up habits.
Designed a fail-safe system with password protection to ensure reliable functionality when NFC tags malfunction.
